after.society: The computer-directed human development order

after.description:
Superior Dominance and selected elites direct reproduction, education and the suppression of Mu. The system’s technical capacity sustains an organized human world while occupations and assigned roles continue. The guarantee best guess is conditional because membership and safety can be withdrawn, although the references do not establish every food or housing rule. This zero variant does not treat computer guidance as proof that all useful human work is unnecessary.

 Effective control lies toward autonomous machine authority, qualified by the administrators operating within it. The modest nonworking scenario counts technical work, assigned service, care, teaching and research. Passing a test or being genetically different is not a participation measure. Wide intervals preserve the ordinary material uncertainty. The same broad control premise appears across the manga and anime, but their individual endings are not merged. The later fate of Mu and humanity does not create an earlier leisure population from victims or a universal successor guarantee.

after.name: Casshan (humans under the robot revolt)
after.society: The living human order under rebel service machines

scope.period: The post-revolt robot-dominated period while human communities remain
scope.population: Living humans under or resisting machine domination
scope.exclusions: The human-derived android hero and robot armies are not extra leisure humans; dead people are excluded.

after.description:
Service automatons rebel and turn their capacities against the human order. The retained point concerns living humans under the resulting machine domination, with support assumed to be insecure and conditional rather than an established welfare system. The zero-variant interpretation keeps real human service, survival effort and resistance visible inside a world with extensive labor-replacing machinery. It does not turn a rebellion alone into proof of automatic abundance.

 Independent rebel machines receive strong control weight relative to humans. Their human-built origin does not guarantee continued human command, while the human-derived android protagonist remains a distinct person rather than another ruler of the entire system. The low nonworking scenario counts recurring assigned labor, care, repair and useful resistance. The wide interval allows substantial variation among surviving communities. Casualties never increase leisure, and a heroic struggle or hoped-for liberation does not establish a completed replacement economy. This remains separate from the later Casshern Sins continuity and its Ruin.

after.name: Casshern Sins (unhealed communities during the Ruin)
after.society: The active unhealed artificial-person communities

scope.continuity: Casshern Sins only; distinct from original Casshan
scope.period: The Ruin period outside Luna’s restoration community
scope.population: Active robot persons still living outside the healing regime
scope.exclusions: Inactive wreckage, dead robots and Luna’s beneficiaries are not blended into this denominator.

after.description:
The Ruin makes bodies decay, leaving active artificial persons dependent on scarce repair and continued functioning. This is not automatically a human post-work economy, so the point uses an explicit synthetic-person proxy. The guarantee best guess lies near the insecure extreme: advanced embodiment no longer ensures reliable access to sustaining resources. The zero variant emphasizes useful effort and material need persisting within a technological civilization.

 Independent artificial communities receive negative control weight relative to human owners, while internal powers and local arrangements remain uncertain. The low nonworking scenario counts useful repair for others, resource work, care-like support and defense. Routine private self-care is not automatically a job, and decaying inactive wreckage is not a person enjoying leisure. The broad interval preserves variation without calling all survivors workers. Luna’s selective restoration is a materially different provider relationship and receives its own point, rather than being averaged into the unhealed population’s insecure floor.

guarantees.basis: Ruin and scarce sustaining resources create very weak security.

control.basis: Independent artificial communities have little human-owner control; internal distribution remains uncertain.

nonworking.basis: Active synthetic-person scenario counts useful repair and support; private self-care and wreckage are not participation.

after.name: Casshern Sins (Luna’s selective restoration)
after.society: The active restoration community around Luna

scope.period: The realized selective healing regime
scope.population: Active robot-person beneficiaries and participants around Luna
scope.exclusions: Unhealed outside communities and inactive remains are separate; healing is not a universal entitlement to every good.

after.description:
Luna’s restoration changes access to continued bodily functioning for selected persons suffering from the Ruin. That is a concrete material difference from the unhealed communities, although the references do not establish a complete wider production system. The guarantee best guess is conditional because healing depends on the provider and does not automatically cover every resident or resource. Technological or biological continuation is therefore not mistaken for unrestricted universal abundance.

 The central control estimate gives the independent higher provider substantial weight, with a wide interval for the less explicit origins and powers of the controller. The moderate nonworking scenario allows relief from survival burdens while counting useful care, maintenance, services and community roles. Active artificial persons form the proxy; healed bodies, inactive remains and absent humans are not a population work ratio. This point concerns the actual selective restoration arrangement, not a claim that immortality eliminates all work or that everyone in the world receives identical support.

control.basis: Independent provider authority receives central weight, with controller origins and powers left broad.
